name: CARSI — paid enrolments
job: Get Australian restoration trainees and technical inspectors to buy an individual course.
audience: Restoration trainees and technical inspectors in Australia, buying their own training.
offer: Individual courses, bought one at a time, priced in AUD with GST included.
proof:
From $20 per course (AUD, GST included)
Prices in AUD, GST included
avoid: we, our, us, my, i; describing CARSI as an RTO; implying IICRC endorsement or guaranteed certification outcomes; the descriptor "IICRC CEC Accredited" or any accreditation claim (VG-02 is unverified); CEC hours on any canvas — an internal number, never a marketing claim; the $795 annual membership (see README); teams pricing ($299 / $799 / $2,499); testimonials, images, likenesses or customer stories without consent evidence; clinical jargon without an on-screen definition; sensational or marketing voice.
